Rune reasoning: Ornn — Searing Charge collision: The selected helper uses armor and/or MR. Conditioning is direct resistance value at minute 30. Aftershock and Unflinching are conditional resistance variants; AP/AD, attack speed and Shield Bash are not substitutes for the resist coefficient. Ability basis: E5 is260+0.4 bonusArmor+0.4 bonusMR via Stat1/6[statFormula=2]. Ornn passive/ramped JakSho increase these; Serylda applies armor penetration to physical E. JakSho boosts bonus resists after5s combat; fully stacked Force of Nature adds70MR. Randuin/Thornmail ea Aftershock: Only real, timely immobilization grants the capped resist buff; do not improve its own triggering hit retroactively. Font of Life: Separate conditional recovery; it does not enlarge the named native heal, shield or attack packet. Conditioning: Minute-12 armor/MR; direct only for matching resistance scaling, otherwise survival utility. Unflinching: Conditional resistances require actual incoming CC and a matching timer; no permanently active bonus. Legend: Haste: Cooldown utility; no extra casts inside a one-cast benchmark. Coup de Grace: Eligible non-true damage only below 40% victim HP; not active on a healthy first hit.

Rune preparation: Conditioning is active after minute 12. Baseline receives no Aftershock or Unflinching resistances unless the authored events really trigger them. A prepared comparison needs real immobilization before scoring and/or actual incoming CC inside the short buff timers. Same-hit Aftershock is not assumed to improve the hit that triggers it.

Rune comparison: Compare an Absolute Focus/Gathering Storm page when AP or AD also scales this helper, versus the real prepared resistance page. Measure client stats and caps instead of recursively multiplying resistance buffs.

Stat shards: Offense haste is utility for this stat/flat-coefficient objective; it is not extra damage per hit. Flex scaling health adds finite max HP; only a recorded HP coefficient or equipped conversion turns that into native output. Defense scaling health is 180 HP at level 18, rather than the old 65-HP shard.

builds.hypothesis: Rank-5 W deals 16% enemy max HP over 0.75s; level-18 Brittle adds the source's level-scaled max-HP magic packet when legally detonated. Neither has a direct AP coefficient. Magic penetration, nearby Abyssal Mask and verified conditional amplifiers can improve these packets even when the purchased AP/AD does not. The physical attack used to trigger Brittle is a separate delivery packet.

Ornn summons a massive lava elemental, which stampedes towards him, dealing [125 / 175 / 225 + (0.2) × AP] magic damage, applying Brittle to, and Slowing enemies hit by [40 / 50 / 60]% for [3] seconds.
